purpose: Test shared omitted core correlation and Hamiltonian terms after the two-method valence n3/n4/n5 sequence, without fitting experimental gf or energies
frozen_input: Sirius runs/valence_sd_v4 n3 separately optimized lower 5So2 and upper 5P1/2/3 orbitals; native bytes/hash retained
grid_control: Pinned RCI getcid.f90 uses RNT=2e-6/Z, H=0.05, N=590 and interpolates the input wavefunctions. Dirac-Coulomb same-CSF control precedes interpretation; its difference from MCDHF is not called a pure Hamiltonian correction.

cases.name: DC
cases.changes: No Breit, VP, recoil or self energy; identical CSFs

cases.name: Breit_static_limit
cases.changes: Only transverse interaction enabled with photon-frequency multiplier 1e-6; other corrections disabled

cases.name: VP_self_energy
cases.changes: VP and self energy through n=3; transverse and recoil disabled; approximate QED model explicitly retained

cases.name: CV_2s_one_hole_DC
cases.changes: Fixed original n3 radial functions; 1s occupation fixed, 2s minimum occupancy one, valence SD through 3d; Dirac-Coulomb only

state_tracking: Preserve native LS compositions, parities and selected root ordinals; reject changed identities rather than choosing states by wavelength or gf agreement
reporting: Native energies and both gauges, all failures and input/executable hashes; no observed-energy substitutions, sigma from gauge spread or automatic adoption
remaining: Radial/SCF and larger active-space/core/1s convergence, stronger forbidden mixing, calibrated uncertainty, distinct source curation and independent human scientific review
